validated.explanation: The deterministic pipeline reports zero physical failure events for this episode and a verdict of success based on end-state geometry. End-of-episode SAM detections place three green plates inside the dish-rack footprint with high confidence and reliable interior containment (E4). Window tracking shows plate presence in 35.0-39.0s and 61.5-65.5s (E6, E7) but no rest→move→rest release event was reconstructed. A measured gripper opening at 62.5s is observed (E5) but holding is not detectable from this joint (E0), so opening alone is not a drop. Uncertainties remain about final positions and orientation verification (E1, E2, E3).

factual_claims.text: Pipeline found no supported physical failure events (n_physical_events=0).
End-of-episode detections show three green plates inside the rack with reliable interior containment: conf 0.9416, 0.9139, 0.9298, geometry_rule reliable_interior_inside.
Episode prediction basis is end_state_inside with latest_window_verdict=uncertain and end_state_verdict=success.
Gripper reading cannot show whether an object is held; a thin plate does not change the closed reading.
Measured gripper opening at frame 1875 (62.5s) with window score 3.1378; opening alone is not a drop and holding is not detectable.
Window track coverage for green plates 1050-1169 (35.0-39.0s) and 1845-1964 (61.5-65.5s) with 120 frames each; no release event reconstructed.
2D containment does not verify upright orientation; orientation failures may remain uncertain.
Not every expected object has an established final position: green plate 0/? established inside.

hypotheses.text: The measured opening at 62.5s may correspond to a release of a plate into the rack, consistent with plates being inside at end-state, but this is not verified as a physical release event by the pipeline.
hypotheses.label: hypothesis

hypotheses.text: Plates appearing inside in 2D could still be incorrectly oriented (e.g., lying flat) which the pipeline explicitly does not verify.
hypotheses.label: hypothesis

visual_interpretations.text: F0 (61.5s) appears to show the red gripper holding a green plate above the rack; F1 (62.5s) shows the gripper near the rack with plates visible inside; F2-F3 show the gripper retracted with three green plates standing in the rack. These are visual impressions only, not verified physical events by the pipeline.
F1 corresponds to the measured gripper opening window, visually consistent with a placement action, but the pipeline states opening alone is not a drop and holding is not detectable.
F3 end-state view shows three green plates inside the rack footprint, matching the SAM inside regions, but 2D containment does not confirm upright orientation.

limitations: Gripper joint cannot indicate holding (E0); open/close measurements do not prove grasp or release.
Final-state inside is 2D image-plane containment vs eroded interior only; orientation not verified (E3, E4).
Window verdicts are uncertain and no rest→move→rest release event was reconstructed (E2, E6, E7).
Object ids from window video vs end-image are not matched across gaps; missing SAM detections are not proof of absence.
